# CL metrics for the route-B five-bench chains (generated by cl_metrics.py)

Benches in learning order: SearchQA → OfficeQA → ZebraLogic → SpreadsheetBench → ALFWorld (step 5 imports a fixed ALFWorld package). R[k][t] = accuracy on bench t of the package frozen after step k plus bench t's instruction card; k = 0 is C. All cells are single reads per item on the held-out test panels. Primary = registered analysis; S = identical-request rule (items whose solver requests are byte-identical to C count as ties). Contrasts are paired, in points (pp).

## 2. CL metrics (pp = percentage points; means over benches, each bench weighted equally)

ACC = mean_t R[K][t]; dACC = mean_t (R[K][t] − R[0][t]); PG = mean_k (R[k][k] − R[k−1][k]); BWT = mean_{t<K} (R[K][t] − R[t][t]); FGT = mean_{t<K} (max_{t≤l<K} R[l][t] − R[K][t]); FWT = mean_{t≥2} (R[t−1][t] − R[0][t]); TS/TD = mean incremental effect R[k][t] − R[k−1][t] of steps that changed the package, on similar / dissimilar benches t ≠ home(k); harmed = off-diagonal cell whose contrast vs C has 95% CI upper bound < 0; informative = rows whose package differs from C; touched = items whose solver request differs from C under the final package; off-target = benches that host no procedure of the package. UPPER BOUND rows are not method effects.
